items.title: Procter & Gamble Targets Up To $10bn In Productivity Savings
items.summary: Procter & Gamble is targeting up to $10 billion (€9.12 billion) in productivity savings from fiscal years 2027-2030, CFO Andre Schulten said.

items.title: Britain And EU Seal Food And Youth Deals
items.summary: Britain and the European Union sealed deals on easing food trade and boosting youth mobility to reset ties at a summit on Friday.

items.title: Nestlé Deep Tech Center signals new era of innovation
items.summary: Nestlé has opened a new Deep Tech Center in Switzerland to accelerate AI, robotics and personalised nutrition innovation, helping the food giant develop products faster, improve manufacturing efficiency and better meet evolving consumer needs.

items.title: Boston Beer names next CEO
items.summary: Chief Operating Officer Phil Hodges will succeed founder Jim Koch, who returned to the helm last year.

items.title: PepsiCo improves deforestation-free sourcing for key commodities
items.summary: The Doritos maker sourced 94% of ingredients such as palm oil and sugar cane without forest clearance in 2025, up from 90% the year before.
